name: My Crush Won't Date Me Unless I Learn How To Fish!
source:
"But... Do you know how to fish?"

Enjoy this visual novel about a person who's willing to do anything for love, including fish!

[From [url=https://ashnin10.itch.io/my-crush-wont-date-me-unless-i-learn-how-to-fish]Itch.io[/url]]
